summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release dated September 20, 2022, reporting New Residential Construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 3a provides seasonally adjusted annual rates for Housing Starts by region (South, Northeast, Midwest, West) and United States Total for monthly periods from August 2021 through August 2022. This enables the calculation of the South's contribution share for August 2022 relative to July 2022, which is the first month of the task's requested window (2022/08–2025/05). A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release reporting New Residential Construction statistics for September 2022 (released October 19, 2022).
